concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 (and 'Execution order' note 'T001 and T002 are independent starting points')
concerns.text: T002 is tagged [P] and declared independent of T001, but its body says 'Use stratified train/val/test split (60/20/20, seed 42)' and its verification asserts 'convergence on a small subset' — a subset of the dataset only T001 produces (data/derived/structural_records_clean.csv). Either T002's tests must be explicitly self-contained (generate their own tiny fixture data) or the [P] tag and 'independent starting point' claim must be removed; as written an implementer running T002 before T001 has no input.

T010 is tagged [P] but consumes outputs of T004–T009 ('every table row and figure traces to an existing result file produced by T003–T009'). The [P] tag is misleading for a consolidation task with explicit upstream dependencies; drop the tag or note it is parallel-safe only with respect to T011/T012.
